name: Persona 4: The Ultimate in Mayonaka Arena
original_name: ペルソナ4 ジ・アルティメット イン マヨナカアリーナ
source:
A fighting game spin-off to both Persona 3 and Persona 4, set immediately after Persona 4, featuring characters from both games.

The story starts 2 months after the events of Persona 4 and roughly 2 years after Persona 3 FES' The Answer. At the start of Golden Week, Narukami Yui returns to Yasoinaba and reunites with Dojima, Nanako and his friends. But soon Chie hears a rumor that the Midnight Channel is airing again and tells Yosuke and Yukiko. The three of them and Yu (coincidentally) see it. At the same time, Rise, Kanji and Teddie go missing and Naoto is busy on a mission. The following day, they head into the TV world and find themselves stuck in a tournament held at their high school where they must fight each other to advance, but during the tournament they see a mysterious girl who claims to be their student council president as well as three Persona-users they've never seen before.

[From [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Persona_4_Arena]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
translation:
這是《女神異聞錄3》和《女神異聞錄4》的格鬥遊戲外傳，故事緊接《女神異聞錄4》，兩作角色都會登場。

故事發生在《女神異聞錄4》事件兩個月後、《女神異聞錄3 FES》的「答案」篇約兩年後。黃金週開始時，鳴上悠回到八十稻羽，與堂島、菜菜子和朋友們重聚。然而，千枝聽說深夜電視再次播出，便告訴陽介和雪子。三人和悠（恰好在場）一起看到了節目。與此同時，久慈川理世、巽完二和小熊失蹤，白鐘直斗正在執行任務。第二天，他們進入電視世界，發現自己被困在高中舉辦的錦標賽中，必須互相戰鬥才能晉級。比賽期間，他們遇見一名自稱學生會長的神秘女孩，以及三名從未見過的人格面具操控者。

[來源：[url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Persona_4_Arena]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
